title: Mode
description: A preset over the one shared memory (MODE-1). Memory is never split by mode. The four built-in modes are focus, student, life and assist; custom modes (MODE-7) use any other short slug.

id.description: focus, student, life, assist, or a custom mode's slug.

description.description: One line on who the mode is for.

allowed_actions.description: Action types Cortex may suggest on its own in this mode. Actions the user asks for directly work in any mode.

auto_run.description: Low-risk action types this mode runs without asking, on its own suggestions only (ACT-4): reminder, notes, flashcards, expense. Each shows in the recap and stays undoable. Empty (the default) means everything waits for approval. Only types also in allowed_actions take effect.

auto_suggest.description: False: Cortex proposes nothing on its own in this mode; it only answers. Default true.

retention_days.description: How long moments captured in this mode are kept; null keeps them until deleted. Shown in settings (MEM-12 applies it).
